name: Emoji & Icon Studio by Kairesh
releaseNotes:
v2.6.0 MediaFetch & Premiere Master Update!
• Added PNG / JPG / SVG format selection directly next to IMG PASTE
• Fixed Premiere Pro 'unsupported compression type' import error
• Auto-convert local and clipboard SVG/WebP assets to high-res PNG for Premiere Pro
• Re-encoded clipboard images to clean standard baseline formats (eliminates codec failure)
• Strictly filtered clipboard drop lists to genuine image files only (ignores video/audio files)
• Manual update popup: easily download & install updates directly from the in-plugin popup modal
